title: PayoutsPostRequestBodyContentApplicationJsonSchemaPayout
description: Data about the payout to create.

amount.description:
The amount of money to pay the customer, in the lowest denomination of currency for the payout.

Min value: `1`

merchant_id.description:
ID of the merchant making the payout.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `128`

grant_id.description:
A grant ID from the Customer Request API that indicates permission to make the payout.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `256`

reference_id.description:
A user-defined identifier for this payout, typically used to associate the payout with a record in an external system.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `1024`

capture.description:
Whether or not to automatically capture the payout once it's created. Must be true until authorization and void payout states are supported.

Default: `true`

note.description:
A note about the payout that will be shown to the customer.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `1024`

Currency.description:
Indicates the country associated with an entity. Values are from the [ISO-4217 Alpha-3](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) specification.

Current values:

- `USD`: United States Dollar
Currency.title: Currency

Metadata.description:
Freeform key-value pairs of arbitrary data associated with this resource.

Keys and values must be passed as strings and not contain any personally identifiable information (PII).

Min keys: `0`
Max keys: `50`


> Note: Nested keys are not supported.
Metadata.title: Metadata

PayoutPurpose.description: The purpose or intent of the payout.
PayoutPurpose.title: PayoutPurpose
